title: units calibration
description: calibration.json: what one recipe measured at its starting commit. The first nine properties are the calibration itself; the rest record where and when it was measured.

recipe_id.description: The recipe this calibration belongs to. A changed recipe, image or harness is another recipe.

runs.description: How many times the test suite ran.

stable.description: Tests that passed every run. A candidate must keep all of them passing.

known_failures.description: Tests that failed every run. A fix candidate can target them.

quarantined.description: Tests that passed some runs and failed others. Never counted.

enabled.description: false: too noisy to resolve the metric's min_effect, or its command failed.

cv.description: Coefficient of variation measured at calibration.

base_value.description: The metric at the starting commit, with the calibration seed.

seed.description: The seed the calibration measured with.

image_digest.description: The image the calibration actually ran on.
